title: Enforce output budgets and bounded progress reporting

intent.outcome: Enforce versioned decision-envelope budgets across ordinary lifecycle output and give long-running compact validation commands bounded periodic progress without flooding logs.
non_goals: Do not hide blockers, proof gaps, uncertainty, residue, or claim boundaries to meet a budget.
Do not introduce parallel compact APIs or truncate payloads after constructing them.
Do not stream captured child output during successful validation runs.

owned: Define byte, field, line, and estimated-token ceilings for named ordinary profiles.
Compress ordinary init output into a decision envelope while retaining explicit verbose drill-down.
Enforce representative cold and warm init/start/report/doctor budgets in package tests.
Emit bounded periodic progress from the compact command runner while child output remains captured.
effects: src/agentic_workspace/contracts/cli_option_groups.json and generated command adapters gain init --verbose.
src/agentic_workspace/workspace_runtime_core.py owns init projection and operational-compression budget evidence.
scripts/check/run_compact_command.py reports elapsed progress at a configurable positive interval.
Focused tests and docs lock output and progress contracts.

next_action: Implement the shared budget contract, init decision envelope, representative lifecycle fixtures, and bounded progress heartbeat.

claims: Enforce output budgets and bounded progress reporting is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: uv run pytest tests/test_workspace_cli.py -k 'ordinary_default_output_budget or init_default' -q
